exposure: types of trained scenarios (e.g., eutocic delivery, vacuum/forceps extraction, breech delivery, cesarean with impacted fetal head, disseminated intravascular coagulation, amniotic fluid embolism, polytrauma in pregnancy, after-coming head retention, maternal cardiac arrest, maternal anaphylaxis)
outcome: identification of critical gaps in training
cohort: The study participants were Ob/Gyn residents in Portugal.
finding: The study identified critical gaps in simulation-based training for obstetric emergencies in Ob/Gyn residency programs across Portugal.
mod_finding: Commonly trained scenarios included eutocic delivery, vacuum and forceps extraction, and breech delivery, while cesarean with impacted fetal head was underrepresented.
